timing: Declared after single-perturbation marker/PCA and synthetic boundary results, before examining dual-perturbation expression outcomes. Metadata only:131 dual labels,41759 cells,min54 per pair, both single arms available for every pair. Prior Norman abstract reports CBL/CNN1 synergy; this is not a blind rediscovery claim.
question: Which observed dual constructs depart from additive single-construct effects on a fixed external-marker score scale? Exploratory conditional-cell associations, not new mechanisms or genetic interactions invariant to measurement scale.
scores: Use the archived marker baseline's exact discovery-control marker eligibility, means and scale_floor0.1. Reproduce its gene parameters and exact discovery/inference cell split before computing outcomes. Normalize all raw genes to10000,log1p,then subset markers. Average eligible standardized markers, min3; divide by that score's discovery-control populationSD. The resulting contrast is in discovery-control scoreSD units.
contrasts: Within each gemgroup compute mean(AB)-mean(A)-mean(B)+mean(inference controls). Each group needs>=2 cells in a usable stratum and>=20 pooled cells. Weight stratum contrasts by dual-cell count among usable strata; retain>=80% of the dual cells. Retain all observed pairs and all9panels, including unavailable comparisons atp1.
inference: Independent-cell Welch-Satterthwaite approximation for the weighted four-group contrast: V=sum_s w_s^2 sum_g sampleVariance_sg/n_sg; df=V^2/sum_sg[(w_s^2 sampleVariance_sg/n_sg)^2/(n_sg-1)]. Two-sided t p-value and95% interval. Holm over all9x131=1179 hypotheses. Flag only adjustedp<.05 and abs(contrast)>=.2 scoreSD. These assumptions are not validated biological independence; shared cells across hypotheses are accommodated by Holm but within-group dependence is not repaired.
target_omission: Separate same-sized Holm family omits BOTH target symbols if present in the panel, requiring>=3 remaining markers and recomputing only that fixed score's discovery-controlSD. A robust flag requires both primary and omission flags with the same sign. No refitting/selection from dual outcomes.
reporting: Keep all pairs and failed/low-power hypotheses, not only favorable interactions. Report CBL+CNN1 as a known-context comparison regardless of outcome, not biological novelty. Exact score-scale additivity need not hold under molecular/count-scale independence; RNA composition, nonlinear log transformation, cell-state mixtures and guide effects can create deviations. Gemgroups and cells are not independent biological samples. Independent experimental validation and full original-paper/supplement review remain required.
archive: Retain complete primary/omission rows, stratum estimates/counts, exact fit/split and source/data/baseline/plan fingerprints, package versions, command, all1179 tests and summary; refuse existing outputs. Keep original data and all primary SAE settings unchanged.
